authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.44 and 20.4.104, R13/R14 object and XRECORD framing.
method: The reusable R13 trace locator validates size and CRC; the shared dictionary walker checks the selected extension dictionary. The bounded XRECORD walker checks its type, self handle, empty EED, body boundary, reactor count, exact 39 source data bytes, owner/reactor roles, typed-null extension handle and alignment. LibreDWG's class and decoded records provide an independent model comparison.
validation: The audit passes both two-element source profiles and the original dictionary-frame helper still passes the prior LibreDWG-generated control.
A changed XRECORD payload with a recomputed valid frame CRC was rejected by the bounded raw-content observer; mutation remained scratch-only.
limits: The selected 39 bytes agree with LibreDWG's three decoded values, but this does not generalize XRECORD parsing or establish the meaning of EXTNAMES.
